name: How long does kitchen tile installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen tile installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen tile installation varies based on the kitchen's size, the complexity of the tile pattern, and the type of tile chosen. A typical kitchen remodel involving new tile can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes preparation, tile setting, grouting, and allowing for proper curing times between stages. Larger kitchens or intricate designs, such as herringbone or mosaics, may extend the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen tile installation typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on kitchen size and tile complexity.
